en.title: Before Lioness, Ian Bohen Was a Fan-Favorite Villain on Teen Wolf
en.summary: Before captivating audiences as Grady in **Paramount+**'s **Lioness**, Ian Bohen honed his acting chops on another hit series. Fans of the supernatural drama **Teen Wolf** will fondly remember his iconic portrayal of a complex antagonist.
en.body:
Long before **Ian Bohen** was navigating the high-stakes world of espionage as K9 handler Grady in **Taylor Sheridan**'s **Lioness**, he was a formidable presence on MTV's beloved supernatural drama, **Teen Wolf**. For years, Bohen embodied the cunning and often terrifying Peter Hale, a character who began as a primary antagonist but evolved into a surprisingly pivotal, albeit morally gray, ally.

Peter Hale was more than just a villain; he was a central figure in the mythology of **Teen Wolf**, a powerful werewolf with a deep connection to the Hale family's tragic past. Bohen's performance brought a compelling blend of menace and vulnerability to the character, making him a fan favorite even during his most villainous arcs. His return to the series in later seasons was met with widespread enthusiasm, cementing his status as a cornerstone of the show's enduring legacy. The actor's ability to shift from antagonist to an essential, if unpredictable, protector demonstrated a remarkable range that resonated deeply with the show's passionate fanbase.

## From Alpha to Operator

The transition from the supernatural forests of Beacon Hills to the gritty realism of military operations in **Lioness** showcases Bohen's versatility. While Peter Hale wielded supernatural powers, Grady operates with tactical precision and a deep bond with his canine unit. This contrast highlights Bohen's capacity to inhabit vastly different characters across genres, yet still deliver performances that feel authentic and engaging. His role as Grady offers a new dimension to his on-screen persona, proving that even seasoned actors can find fresh challenges and captivating roles that speak to a new generation of viewers.

## Fan Reactions and Legacy

For fans who grew up with **Teen Wolf**, seeing **Ian Bohen** back on a prominent series like **Lioness** is a treat. The memory of Peter Hale’s complex journey – from psychotic alpha to reluctant guardian – is still fresh for many. His ability to play characters with such a strong presence, whether they are battling mythical creatures or executing covert missions, is a testament to his talent. The reappearance of such a recognizable and beloved actor in a high-profile role often sparks conversations among fan communities, celebrating the actor's career trajectory and anticipating his contributions to the new narrative.

## What's Next

As **Lioness** continues its run on **Paramount+**, fans will be keen to see how Grady's character develops and whether he maintains his connection with the K9 unit. The show's intricate plotlines and ensemble cast promise further exploration of these dynamics.

content_raw: Lioness' Grady may love the dogs in his K9 unit, but the canines Ian Bohen worked with in the past can't exactly be described as "man's best friend" ...
